title: Bert Trautmann – the goalkeeper with a broken neck

scenes.text: This goalkeeper won a cup final... with a broken neck.
But that's not even the craziest part of his story.
Bert Trautmann was a German paratrooper in the Second World War.
In 1945, he was captured... and sent to a prisoner of war camp in England.
When the war ended, he didn't go home. He stayed... and started playing in goal.
In 1949, Manchester City signed him. Thousands of fans protested. They wanted him gone.
So he did the only thing he could. He made save... after save... after save.
And slowly, the boos turned into cheers.
May 1956. The FA Cup final at Wembley. 75 minutes in, he dives at a striker's feet... and takes a knee to the neck.
There were no substitutes back then. So he gets up... and keeps playing.
He makes more saves. City win 3-1!
Three days later, an x-ray shows the truth. His neck was broken.
The man they wanted gone... became a club legend. Follow for more football stories.
